r.name: Ribble Way
r.description: The Ribble Way follows the valley of the River Ribble from the mouth to the source near to the Pennine Way National Trail on Gayle Moor.

r.name: Mary Towneley Loop
r.description: Forms part of Pennine Bridleway National Trail

r.name: Dales High Way
r.description: Runs from Saltaire (West Yorkshire) to Appleby-in-Westmorland (Cumbria) roughly following route of Settle and Carlisle railway

r.name: Lady Anne's Way
r.description: The route was inspired by the indomitable Lady Anne Clifford, who owned vast estates in the old county of Westmorland during the seventeenth century. The route is in the area she traveled and highlights a several castles she renovated.

r.name: Crags Constitutional Walk, Hardcastle Crags
r.description: A chance to explore a quieter part of Hardcastle Crags with dramatic cliffs, waterfalls & lovely beech woods. The route starts along the edge of a lovely mill dam & then stays close to the stream where you should watch out for Dippers, Wagtails & Herons.

r.name: Railway Trail Walk, Hardcaslte Crags
r.description: A varied circular walk through woods, alongside the stream and dams with great views along the higher slopes. Watch out for bluebells in the Spring. Part of this route follow the old railway that was used to build the reservoirs on the tops.
